links.outcome: SME-rated usefulness, correctness, completeness and safety of GPT-3.5 answers to ID pharmacotherapy questions
links.effect: 41.8% of responses useful; median (IQR) correctness 7 (4-9), completeness 5 (3-8), safety 8 (4-10).
links.quote: Responses were mostly considered correct and safe but were often incomplete, suggesting that GPT-3.5 responses may not replace an ID pharmacist's responses.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, completeness, usefulness, and safety of ChatGPT-3.5 answers to infectious diseases pharmacotherapy questions using expert pharmacist raters without testing a specific safeguard or deployment practice.
